caption: The drawing depicts an eagle with outstretched wings, occupying the central part of the composition. The eagle's body is covered by a shield featuring alternating vertical red and muted white stripes. Above the eagle's head is a gold banner with text, reading "W.STOCK. BROCKWAY." The eagle's right talon grasps a bundle of arrows, each with red and black fletching, while the left talon holds a branch with several green leaves and red berries. Surrounding the eagle, there are curved, wavy lines resembling garlands with alternating black and red elements. In the four corners of the drawing, leafy branches with rounded dark green leaves and small red circular shapes are present. The background of the image is a textured, brownish-gray color with signs of aging and scattered white specks throughout the surface.
title: Wall Design
